demo.title: Demo controls
demo.description: Persona, content changes, and failure scenarios stay in this browser and never connect to a real account or production service.

routeSupport.title: This route is not supported yet
routeSupport.message: The page is part of the public route contract, but the first demo release does not yet provide an acceptance-ready local behavior. The demo will not fill the gap with fake success or production requests.
routeSupport.recovery: Use a route marked interactive or read-only, or wait for a later release to complete this domain.

demo.resetFailed: Demo data could not be reset. Check browser storage and try again.

capabilities.title: Production capability boundaries
capabilities.description: The local demo never connects these capabilities to real services; pages expose their status, dependency, and recovery path.

gitea.title: Gitea source repositories
gitea.description: Demo mode does not synchronize a Gitea identity, read repositories, or redirect to a real source service.
gitea.dependency: A same-origin Gitea service and identity bridge.
gitea.recovery: Switch to integration or official mode and configure a compatible Gitea adapter.

code-server.title: code-server workspaces
code-server.description: Demo mode does not create, poll, or open a remote code workspace.
code-server.recovery: Switch to integration or official mode and configure a compatible workspace adapter.

renderer.title: Remote Renderer
renderer.description: Demo mode does not submit or poll production render jobs; local reading previews remain available.
renderer.dependency: An asynchronous document renderer and job API.
renderer.recovery: Switch to integration or official mode and configure a compatible renderer adapter.

quiver.title: Quiver diagrams
quiver.description: Demo mode does not load the Quiver iframe or call a real diagram API.
quiver.dependency: A same-origin Quiver application and diagram API.
quiver.recovery: Switch to integration or official mode and explicitly enable the Quiver application.

payments.title: Payments and sponsorship
payments.description: Demo mode does not create orders, submit payment forms, poll payment status, or process real callbacks.
payments.dependency: An order service, payment-provider credentials, and server-side callback verification.
payments.recovery: Restore this only in an official deployment with the payment backend explicitly enabled.

sms.title: SMS verification
sms.description: Demo identities are local browser personas; they never send an SMS or create a production account.
sms.dependency: A supported authentication provider and configured server-side SMS sender.
sms.recovery: Configure integration or official authentication and its server-side SMS sender.

real-upload.title: Real file uploads
real-upload.description: The demo stores images up to 2 MB in its local repository; PDF, archive, and object-storage uploads are unavailable.
real-upload.dependency: A compatible object store and upload authorization service.
real-upload.recovery: Keep using the local image simulation, or configure an upload adapter in integration or official mode.
